explanation.definitionFit: A commentator is a broadcaster who describes events as they happen, such as a match.

clue.text: Vehicle: incentive to lose rust?

clue.text: Privileged group exciting radical cleric

parts.note: taken as written

clue.text: Former partner the reverse of satisfied and opening without preparation

parts.note: fifty per cent is a half

clue.text: Opening about to come up after further development

clue.text: Completely dismissed description of intensive activity

clue.text: Music perverted to have a disco hue?

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: Acid house is a style of electronic dance music from the late 1980s rave scene.

clue.text: Junior officer's role to provide story linked to university occupation

clue.text: Emperor's consort: "In France I may accept his open fooling around"

indicators.note: the French pronoun takes the other letters inside it

parts.note: je is French for I

parts.note: taken as written

clue.text: English officer has overthrown target, getting commendations

parts.note: an NCO is a non-commissioned officer

clue.text: Devious aspect to fox, in retrospect

parts.note: taken as written

clue.text: Others upset about a measure of audibility

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Other people get annoyed about how far a sound carries.
explanation.definitionFit: Earshot is the range within which a sound can be heard.

clue.text: Location of one elevated hermit's collected announcements?

definitions.meaning: a stylite was a hermit who lived atop a pillar
the newspaper section gathering private notices and messages

explanation.surface: Asks where a pillar-dwelling hermit's gathered messages might be found.
explanation.walkthrough: Read literally, it is the pillar belonging to a single stylite; in a paper, it is the small-ads section.
explanation.definitionFit: A newspaper's personal column carries private notices, messages and small advertisements.

clue.text: Outcome sees despot beheaded, amongst other things

explanation.definitionFit: A resultant is something that results, a consequence, as in a resultant force.

clue.text: See 13
Not acceptable to have healthier tailor

clue.text: High-class line performed, amidst rising laughter

clue.text: Nurse is turning back, dropping note

clue.text: Beginning to produce articles about the gods?

parts.note: taken as written

clue.text: See 2
Director collapsed going to India

clue.text: Some lovers met, immediately turning up as couples

parts.note: taken as written

clue.text: Dead bear beginning to go off in the rain?

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its first letter

parts.note: taken as written

clue.text: Merged fuel and key sources of electricity delivery

clue.text: Insubstantial Government entity

parts.note: thin as in a thin argument, lacking substance

clue.text: See 7
Female and male adopting positive form of dress for worker in the field

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A woman and a man agree on a cheerful style of clothing for farm labour.
